scope: guest Chat Store acceptance script only
changes: Open the actual public demo page in the owned browser profile, append a per-run article with a unique heading and two unpredictable check codes, and preserve the page's existing content and URL path.
Before each send, query the extension's active browser tab and require the public demo fixture URL to be active.
Require the first real guest answer to include its page-only code and all three workflow stages.
Reload the native side panel, recheck guest session absence and Chat access, then send a new guest turn and require its separate page-only code and fixture heading.
Record only nonce fingerprints and boolean answer checks; retain a sanitized failure stage, code, and reason without answer transcripts or credentials.
limit: A real guest completion remains unverified until the root-owned native acceptance run exercises the script.
